UNUSUAL WAR PHOTOGRAPHS, FIRST IN THE UNITED STATES SHOWING TURKISH SOLDIERS OF THE DESERT ON THEIR WAY TO THE FRONT, IN THE BALKAN-TURKISH WAR.

TO THE DEFENSE OF CONSTANTINOPLE AND
THE RELIGION OF THEIR FATHERS.

Turkish Regulars of the Infantry Division on their long and weary tramp from Bagdad, the far eastern extremity of the Turkish Empire towards the defense of Constantinople in the last stand of the Ottoman against Christianity. They are in Khaki uniform and in heavy marching order, fully equipped with modern rifles. They have been drilled in accordance with the German Army methods even to the peculiar German "goose-step" march. Their endurance which is unexcelled by the soldiers of any army in the world is demonstrated by the long "hike" of about 1200 miles across the hot desert sands.
